dedupe_keys.name: five lipo cells capacity impedance and fitted circuit parameters

description: This dataset contains charge–discharge, capacity and impedance measurements for five BAK Technology LP-503562-IS-3 lithium-polymer cells tested by University of Rome Tor Vergata researchers. Standard and stress cycling track capacity over hundreds of cycles, while impedance spectra at several states of charge are accompanied by equivalent-circuit fits and parameter uncertainties. The repository documents CSV column definitions and groups files by cell, cycle and test type. Mendeley provides free access under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is a laboratory ageing experiment on one cell model, not a dated grid-storage fleet. The repository labels real and imaginary impedance columns with W, an apparent unit inconsistency that must be resolved before fitting or reuse. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating degradation and equivalent-circuit components for battery simulations. model-system-advisor-model-sam is a related project-level storage resource, requiring an additional translation from cell measurements. No CSV values or fitted parameters were checked.
